name: ProdLi: AI Meeting Notes & Daily Planner
description: AI meeting notes with no bot for Meet, Zoom and Teams, and a new tab that plans your day: brief, to-dos, notes, habits, focus.

toggle-recording.description: Start or stop recording the current call (Meet, Zoom, Teams, Webex, Slack, Discord…)

dictate.description: Dictate: talk instead of typing in any text box (press again, or release after holding, to finish)

mark-moment.description: Mark this moment of the meeting you're recording as important

quick-add.description: Quick add a to-do or note to ProdLi

insert-snippet.description: Insert a saved snippet into the text box you're typing in

check-writing.description: Check the writing in the text box you're typing in (spelling, grammar, clarity)

action.default_title: ProdLi — click on a call's tab (Meet, Zoom, Teams, Webex, Slack, Discord…) to record
